净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Mutation of the qualified drawdown wick-absorption factor targeting predictive stability, especially RankICIR, while preserving its positive payoff and monotonicity strengths. The lower-wick absorption component is smoothed over 16 bars instead of 12, reducing sensitivity to isolated candles and noisy short-lived reversals without adding a new feature family or materially changing the economic mec

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

drawdown_depth_50 × mean_16[((min(open, close)-low)/(high-low)) × ((close-low)/(high-low))] / [1 + ts_sum(12, max(0,-log(C_t/C_{t-1})))]
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📚 字段与算子释义

输入字段

字段含义说明
open开盘价基础行情字段
high最高价基础行情字段
low最低价基础行情字段
close收盘价基础行情字段
volume成交量基础行情字段
drawdown_depth_5050% 回撤深度回撤深度达到 50% 级别的度量
mean_1616 日均值16 日均值

算子

算子含义
minmin(x, n) → 滚动最小 / 逐点最小
ts_sumts_sum(x, n) → 滚动求和
maxmax(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大
loglog(x) → 自然对数

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

drawdown_depth_50 × mean_16[((min(open, close)-low)/(high-low)) × ((close-low)/(high-low))] / [1 + ts_sum(12, max(0,-log(C_t/C_{t-1})))]

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high：high
  2. 计算 low：low
  3. 计算 open_：open
  4. 计算 close：close
  5. 计算 eps：np.finfo(float).eps
  6. 计算 safe_close：close.clip(lower=eps)
  7. 计算 bar_range：(high - low)
  8. 计算 wick_base：np.minimum(open_, close)
  9. 计算 lower_wick：((wick_base - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
  10. 计算 close_location：((close - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
  11. 计算 absorption：(lower_wick * close_location).滚动窗口(16, min_periods=16).mean()
  12. 计算 high_water：safe_close.滚动窗口(50, min_periods=50).max().clip(lower=eps)
  13. 计算 depth：(1.0 - safe_close / high_water).clip(lower=0.0)
  14. 计算 prior_close：safe_close.shift(1)
  15. 计算 downside_damage：((-np.log(safe_close / prior_close)).clip(lower=0.0)).滚动窗口(12, min_periods=12).sum()
  16. 计算 signal：depth * absorption / (1.0 + downside_damage)

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  2. log(C_t/C_{t-1}) — log(x) → 自然对数

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_smooth16(df): """Measure smoothed lower-wick absorption ">class="kw">while price remains underwater.""" df_copy = df.copy() high = df_copy["high"] low = df_copy["low"] open_ = df_copy["open"] close = df_copy["close"] eps = np.finfo(float).eps safe_close = close.clip(lower=eps) bar_range = (high - low).replace(0.0, np.nan) wick_base = np.minimum(open_, close) lower_wick = ((wick_base - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0) close_location = ((close - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0) absorption = (lower_wick * close_location).rolling(16, min_periods=16).mean() high_water = safe_close.rolling(50, min_periods=50).max().clip(lower=eps) depth = (1.0 - safe_close / high_water).clip(lower=0.0) prior_close = safe_close.shift(1) downside_damage = ((-np.log(safe_close / prior_close)).clip(lower=0.0)).rolling(12, min_periods=12).sum() signal = depth * absorption / (1.0 + downside_damage) df_copy["factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_smooth16"] = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_smooth16"]
